name: Koren boxes: four solenoid pairs, temporal burst-firing, 30 min (Tsang 2004 Shakti comparison)
origin: Persinger & Koren lab, Laurentian University ('Koren boxes'); compared with Shakti by Tsang, Koren & Persinger 2004
summary: The lab's own arm of Tsang, Koren & Persinger 2004: burst-firing through the temporal lobes from four left-right solenoid pairs ('Koren boxes'), 30 min in three weekly sessions, compared with the vendor's Shakti and with sham, 4 people per arm. The paper reports no treatment differences except one high-alpha interaction, which it ascribes mainly to Shakti.
notes: Tsang 2004 compared Shakti, the lab's Koren boxes and sham, four people each (p.3 [1015]). Each box held four sets of solenoids; the burst-firing pattern was 'presented for about .7 s once every 3 s across the temporoparietal lobes' for 30 min, with 3-ms points (p.5 [1017]). The fields were generated between each of the four pairs of solenoids every 0.5 s (2 s per cycle) through the brain (p.6 [1018]). It is the method of Baker-Price and Persinger 1996 (p.3 [1015]): see persinger-tbi-depression-temporal. This program plays a 690-ms burst (230 points of 3 ms), then 3 s of silence, reading 'once every 3 s' as the pause, and moves to the next pair every 0.5 s: one left-right pair is on at a time, and the right side is reversed so that the pair's field points through the head. The four sites per side stand for the lab helmet's four solenoids per side on a 7.5 by 5 cm ellipse; the site names are this project's reading. The burst is the project's rising sweep with the published point duration and length; the point values were never published as numbers (the lab prints the shape only as a small figure). The paper states no field strength for these boxes, only for the Shakti arm (p.5-6 [1017-1018]); 1 uT is this project's choice. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. Support: the sham group wore the boxes or the Shakti helmet with the computers off; who knew the allocation is not stated (p.5 [1017]). The paper's one significant term, in high alpha, is one among eight treatment terms in six bands (Table 1, p.7 [1019]). One lab. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Other arms: persinger-shakti-arm-tsang-2004 and sham. Not for anyone with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop on headache, nausea or distress.
setting: Seated or reclined, eyes closed, in a quiet, dark room (the lab's standard was a blindfold in an acoustic chamber). Record EEG before each session to compare with the paper.
schedule: 30 min once a week for three weeks. The lab recorded EEG on 4 successive weeks, each time before the exposure, and reports changes after 3 treatments.
source: Tsang, Koren & Persinger 2004, Int J Neurosci 114:1013 (Shakti vs Koren boxes) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15527205/ ; Martin, Koren & Persinger 2004, Int J Neurosci 114:1259 (.wav through a coil worked, compact disc did not) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15370185/ ; Murphy, Shakti Spiritual Technology & Koren Helmet - A Comparison https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/koren_shakti.htm ; Carniello 2020, PhD thesis, Laurentian University (230-point burst-firing file, 3 ms) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/8c92763c-cd19-4a21-b242-3b572a28ce55 ; Martin & Persinger 2004, Neurosci Lett 366:226 (burst-firing once every 4 s) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15276252/ ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
